title: Get paid: your ID and bank account
summary: Add your ID and bank account once. Deposits and pay links then go straight to your bank.

steps.title: Open Get paid
steps.body: On a phone, tap More, then Get paid. On a computer, go to Settings, then Get paid.

steps.title: Add your ID
steps.body: Pick your ID (NIN slip or card, driver's licence, passport or voter's card), type your full name as it is on it, and add a photo of the front. Say whether you're registered with CAC; if you are, add your BN or RC number and certificate. Not being registered doesn't stop you taking payments. Tap "Send for review".

steps.title: Add your bank account
steps.body: Pick your bank and type your account number. Tikka shows the account name from your bank: check it's yours and confirm. Tikka keeps the bank, the last 4 digits and the name, never the full number.

steps.title: Wait for the check
steps.body: Tikka checks your details, usually within 1 working day, and tells you on WhatsApp. If something needs fixing, Get paid says what. Once you're Verified, payments switch on.

tips: Tikka never holds your money. Paystack sends each payment to your bank the next working day.
Your ID is only seen by Tikka's team, to check your business.
